unidades.resumo_pedagogico: Introduction to basic English communication for 3rd grade: greetings and everyday phrases (Hello, Hi, Good morning, Good afternoon, Goodbye, Bye-bye); asking and telling names ('What is your name? - My name is...', 'Who are you?'); asking about feelings ('How are you? - I'm fine / happy / sad, thank you'); numbers from 1 to 20 with spelling and counting games; primary and secondary colours (red, blue, yellow, green, orange, purple, pink, brown, black, white); classroom instructions (Sit down, Stand up, Open your book, Listen, Look, Be quiet); school objects vocabulary (book, pencil, pen, rubber, ruler, pencil case, sharpener, scissors, glue stick, schoolbag, desk, chair).

conceitos_chave.definicao: Formas de saudação e despedida em inglês: Hello/Hi (Olá), Good morning (Bom dia), Good afternoon (Boa tarde), Goodbye (Adeus).
Contagem e escrita dos números ordinais e cardinais de um a vinte (one, two, three, four, five... ten, eleven, twelve... twenty).
Vocabulário essencial do material escolar e mobília da sala de aula (pencil case = estojo, rubber = borracha, ruler = régua, book = livro).
Identificação e descrição das cores dos objetos: red, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, pink, brown, black, white.

unidades.resumo_pedagogico: Exploring family relationships, feelings and physical descriptions in English: family tree vocabulary (mother/mum, father/dad, parents, brother, sister, grandmother/granny, grandfather/grandad, grandparents, baby, cousin, aunt, uncle); expressing ownership with possessive adjectives ('my', 'your', 'his', 'her'); descriptive adjectives for people (tall, short, young, old, happy, energetic, kind); identifying family roles and asking 'Who is this? - This is my brother/sister'; feelings and states of mind (tired, hungry, thirsty, scared, excited, angry).

conceitos_chave.definicao: Membros do agregado familiar em inglês: mother, father, brother, sister, grandmother, grandfather.
Vocabulário de estados emocionais: happy, sad, excited, tired, hungry, thirsty.
Determinantes possessivos para indicar pertença ('This is my mother', 'Is that your dog?').

unidades.resumo_pedagogico: Describing the human body, facial features and seasonal clothing: head, face, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, teeth, hair (blond, dark, curly, straight, long, short), shoulders, knees, toes, arms, hands, legs, feet. The famous traditional song and action chant 'Head, shoulders, knees and toes'; clothing items for different weather conditions (T-shirt, shirt, jumper/sweater, jacket, coat, trousers, jeans, shorts, dress, skirt, socks, shoes, boots, trainers, hat, scarf, gloves); using the present continuous construction 'I am wearing...' and 'He/She is wearing a red coat'.

conceitos_chave.definicao: Partes do corpo humano: head, shoulders, knees, toes, eyes, ears, mouth, nose.
Peças de vestuário e calçado: T-shirt, trousers, shoes, socks, jacket, dress.
Estrutura para descrever a roupa que alguém traz vestida ('She is wearing blue jeans').

unidades.resumo_pedagogico: Vocabulary for healthy eating, meals, animals and nature: food items (apple, banana, orange, strawberry, grapes, bread, cheese, butter, sandwich, pizza, salad, chicken, fish, soup, rice, pasta); drinks (water, milk, orange juice, tea); expressing likes and dislikes ('I like bananas', 'I don't like cheese', 'Do you like apples? - Yes, I do / No, I don't'); pets and farm animals (dog, cat, rabbit, bird, fish, hamster, cow, horse, pig, sheep, duck, chicken); wild and zoo animals (lion, tiger, elephant, giraffe, monkey, snake); animal abilities with modal 'can' and 'can't' (Birds can fly; fish can swim; dogs can run).

conceitos_chave.definicao: Alimentos e bebidas: apple, banana, sandwich, pizza, water, milk, orange juice.
Estruturas de preferências pessoais: 'I like...' (Gosto de...) e 'I don't like...' (Não gosto de...).
Animais domésticos e selvagens e ações com 'can' (fly, swim, jump, run).

unidades.resumo_pedagogico: Everyday actions, daily routines and cut-out review games: daily verbs and habits (wake up, wash my face, brush my teeth, get dressed, have breakfast, go to school, play in the playground, have lunch, do homework, watch television, have dinner, go to bed); times of the day (morning, afternoon, evening, night); days of the week (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday); using the interactive textbook cut-outs ('Miniflashers') for pair work vocabulary recall, memory games and end-of-year comprehensive review.

conceitos_chave.definicao: Ações quotidianas: wake up, brush my teeth, have breakfast, go to school, go to bed.
Os sete dias da semana em inglês: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
Cartões didáticos recortáveis do manual Easy-Peasy para jogos interativos e consolidação de vocabulário.
